notes: USD per 1 million tokens. Conservative standard/peak/upper-tier rates are used where pricing varies by prompt length, time, or region. Taxes, tool calls, negotiated discounts, batch discounts, and cache storage charges are excluded.

claude_opus_5.pricing_basis: Claude API global pricing with a 5-minute cache write. A 1-hour cache write costs $10 per million tokens and is not represented by this flat entry.

gpt_5_6_sol.pricing_basis: Promotional GPT-5.6 Sol pricing available at least through 2026-11-21. Prompts above 272K input tokens have additional multipliers not represented by this flat entry.

gemini_3_1_pro.pricing_basis: Conservative Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview Standard tier for prompts above 200K tokens. The <=200K tier is $2 input, $0.20 cached input, and $12 output. Cache storage is excluded.

glm_5_3.pricing_basis: Z.AI standard GLM-5.3 pricing. Cached-input storage is listed as temporarily free and is excluded from the estimator.

kimi_k3.pricing_basis: Official Kimi API pay-as-you-go pricing with automatic context-cache hit pricing.

deepseek_v4_pro_0813.pricing_basis: Conservative DeepSeek-V4-Pro peak-time rates. Official off-peak input, cached input, and output rates are half these values.

qwen_3_8_max_0902.pricing_basis: QwenCloud pay-as-you-go rates using automatic implicit caching; explicit caching is not enabled.
